This is a NEW storyboard, not an edit to the supplied frame. Portrait page, TWO columns by THREE rows, exactly SIX generously sized portrait panels, black gutters, tiny clear white panel numbers 01 to 06 only, no other captions or branding added outside scenes.
01: over-shoulder three-quarter view at home desk, woman wearing small black headset with visible boom microphone, laptop clearly shows video meeting grid of adults; stiff frustrated pose, phone appointment reminder on desk (simple generic notification, no need for legible text).
02: same desk, furious woman pulls headset off with one hand as other hand slams laptop lid shut, strong comic angular pose.
03: low rear third-person camera, woman busts front door outward and strides through with exaggerated gangster swagger, black handbag on shoulder.
04: Singapore bus stop, single-deck white bus with purple lower body and red roof strip, front passenger doors open on LEFT curb side, crowd of adult commuters stepping off; woman in maroon runs around nose toward right-hand driving cab, same bus all panels.
05: tight exterior view at RIGHT driver's side, woman yanks adult bus driver through smashed cab side window in one exaggerated video-game gesture, small glass fragments, driver surprised and clearly alive, no blood or visible injury. Exactly ONE glowing wanted star in upper corner.

Maintain same woman and bus. Warm Singapore daylight, retro textured low-poly rendered frames, dramatic legible action. Non-graphic slapstick. Do not draw photorealistic humans, comic speech bubbles, real casualty imagery or random HUD text.
